data.name: Arelia
data.gender_notes: Arelia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘arere’ meaning ‘to prepare, provide for’, Arelia is a name of divine origin. In Christian tradition, Arelia symbolizes the spiritual journey towards enlightenment, representing God's provision and protection for the faithful. The name Arelia carries the meaning “God's provision” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Arelia usually hope their child will grow to embody god's provision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's divine provision and protection.
data.etymology: Arelia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's provision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arelia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

It represents the journey towards enlightenment and the divine protection that God provides throughout this journey. data.spiritual_symbolism: Arelia signifies the radiance and strength of God's love. It is derived from the name Ara, meaning altar, and El, meaning God. Thus, Arelia represents an altar of God's love, a beacon of divine presence and power.
